notes.title: 小型更新v0.3.7
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new challenge stage "Land of Abundance" — unleash magic and defeat enemies!
[*] Brand-new main interface upgrade! More intuitive level previews and easier selection.
[*] Added five new magic cards.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased coin acquisition speed when upgrading.
[*] Optimized long-range attacks for towers and archers (fixed issues with projectiles being lost when multiple arrows target the same enemy).
[*] Even if you fail a challenge, you will still gain experience and talent points.
[*] Added the ability to cancel magic card casting by right-clicking.
[*] When the hero dies, magic card and skill cooldowns will continue to count down.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[] Fixed an issue where missile towers wouldn't explode if their target died.
[] Fixed an issue where the magic aura wouldn't disappear if the hero died while casting a magic card.
[] Fixed an issue where 【Gale Gunner】 couldn't attack rocks on suspension bridges.
[] Fixed occasional teleport malfunctioning in the 【Forge Core】 stage.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update v0.3.7
notes.content:
[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Missile Tower, Gatling Tower, and Sniper Tower now have unique projectile trajectories and hit effects.
[*] Press ALT to view the current tower type.
[*] Optimized performance to reduce lag.
[*] Empowering Stones will no longer be reclaimed when reloading a save.
[*] Hero CEO’s turrets now benefit from both building bonuses and hero attack bonuses.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the experience farming bug—now, experience and talent points are only granted upon victory.
[*] Fixed an issue where shields were stacking abnormally.
[*] Fixed the "Seven-Day Login" ability not granting Empowering Stones after reloading a save.
[*] Fixed the "Titan God" ability not affecting Overclass Mages.
[/list]

notes.title: New Heroes! New Maps! New Abilities! New Mechanics!
notes.content:
[b]Next, let's introduce the content of this update. First, the new additions:[/b]
[h3]New Atlas[/h3]
Includes information on various enemies, heroes, buildings, and abilities, allowing for a more intuitive understanding of the game content.
[h3]New Player Leveling System[/h3]
Heroes can now gain experience through battles and level up, unlocking more diverse abilities to be used in stages.
[h3]New Building Upgrade System[/h3]
Our arrow towers now have three types and nine variants, which can be combined with abilities to create more interesting effects.
[h3]New Active Skills[/h3]
You can actively cast some spells, which may help you turn the tide of battle.
[h3]New Map[/h3]
New stage "City of Eternal Frost" added.
[h3]New Special Mode[/h3]
A new special mode gameplay has been added, allowing you to experience completely different gameplay on previously known maps.
[h3]New Heroes[/h3]
Two new heroes added: Blacksmith-CEO; Mage-Archmage.
[h3]New Buildings[/h3]
Two new buildings added: Slow Tower and Miner Tower, which will appear in future stages.
[b]While updating with new content, we have also made some functional improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 50+ new abilities, expanding bd gameplay.
[*]Increased talent point acquisition, considering player feedback on the difficulty of obtaining talent points, corresponding adjustments have been made.
[*]Heroes are in a default running state, no need to hold down shift for a long time to run, freeing your pinky finger.
[*]Optimized soldier movement and garrison functions, now you can select your soldiers and command them.
[/list]

[img]https://ziyue-game.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/Notice/0.3.4-1.gif[/img]

The above is the content of this update. Soon, the next update plan will be revealed, and we will complete it as scheduled.
Everyone is welcome to join our QQ group for enjoyable discussions and to give pointers for the next version: [u][b]978785681[/b][/u]
Sincerely, the development team of "The Last Line of Defense," thank you for the support of all our shareholders.
[h2][u][i]Thank you all for your support![/i][/u][/h2][/img][/url]

notes.title: New feature launched: Soldiers stationed and summoned, with more flexible strategies!
notes.content:
1. Soldier garrison function
Function description: You can assign soldiers to station in specific locations (such as near arrow towers, city walls, or key buildings), and also flexibly deploy formations to encircle and suppress enemies from multiple directions.
Usage: After selecting the troops, click the "G" button, and then specify the garrison location to take effect.
2. Soldier summoning function
Function Description: With the new summoning command, you can easily summon scattered soldiers to the hero's side and quickly assemble troops to deal with sudden battles.
Usage: After selecting the troops, click the "R" button, and the soldiers in the current barracks will automatically go.
3. Optimize some sound effects to enhance the overall auditory experience.
Improved gameplay after update
Troop management is more convenient, and defense and offense are smoother.
The newly added garrison mechanism encourages you to allocate resources reasonably and strengthen strategic thinking.
The summoning function allows you to quickly turn the tide of the battle, no longer worrying about the time-consuming deployment of troops
In the near future, we will release more fun and challenging new maps to bring you a richer gaming experience. Stay tuned!

notes.title: The Mac version has been launched!
notes.content:
So nice! The latest news is that the Mac version has also been launched, but of course, this is not our most important news.
After several days of discussion, we have decided to start preparing for new gameplay. Additionally, many of our friends' desired endless mode will also be phased out, but it will be available to everyone after a few small updates. Please don't worry.
There are still many people who are worried about whether we will run away. Please don't worry about this. Running away won't happen, and we will always ensure a high frequency of updates.
Oh, by the way, there's also a leave note. I might take a break during the Spring Festival because my buddies are still going home for the holiday
Everyone can move to the QQ group to have a pleasant discussion with us and point out the next version: 978785681

notes.title: Multi language version launched
notes.content:
OI! Friends!
Last Stand:Defense has been available on Steam for over a week now. However, due to a lack of manpower within the team, limited operational experience, and budget constraints, we initially only had English and Chinese versions of the game. Fortunately, we've made some progress, and while working on new maps and gameplay features, we've also released additional language versions. We hope this will allow more players to enjoy our game.
